set.body: Consumer ephys4s has a reproducible JavaFxRenderer/JavaFxCanvasContext boundary observation on canonical aad4e0e25bc5c20af8158131d04a757b1e894a1a, JDK25.0.4.1+1, OpenJFX27+30, macOS12 x86_64, headless1 and ordinary window2. After repeated native A/B condition redraws, opaque1x32 ERSP/ITC gradient source images retain correct blue/grey/red channel bounds, but individual Canvas snapshots contain yellow pixels near bottom edge (e.g light ITC blue0..13 versus source minimum109). ephys4s native-control-details/check-3 and onscreen-1 preserve complete scenes/source pixels, individual Canvas and workspace-before/after captures, exact origins and read-only channel audit colorbar-observations-3.json. Cross-reference root ephys4s-provider-intaglio-gradient-edge and ephys4s-f-ui-v2-colorbar-redraw. Current named branch fix/javafx-gradient-edge starts at unpublished boundary-test fix d6bb0fc5; no production change yet. First isolate renderer/adapter versus a pure JavaFX drawImage reproduction. Expected: native gradient paint remains within its opaque source/background channel bounds at edges; no artificial yellow values or stale image state. Acceptance: minimal meaningful owning regression for repeated draws and relevant scales, preserve exact source RGBA/geometry, correct defect in owner or document concrete runtime defect/removal condition for any temporary workaround, pass supported provider tests and affected Canvas/JavaFX/native consumers, explicit unavailable-platform skips. No consumer repaint/color-masking workaround or publication without authorization.
set.title: Isolate native gradient bottom-edge colors outside the source raster palette
